notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated. Primary goal: embed in-app assistant + semantic search for product docs and support, reduce latency for live assist.

POC highlights:
- Jan 12 demo (Fireflies ff_2026-01-12_01) showed hosted API integration (serverless) — devs liked SDK and streaming.
- Jan 28 pricing deep-dive: requested dedicated pricing scenarios for committed capacity + burst.
- POC used 2 model variants: open-llama-70B-quant and rw-instruct-small for routing fallback. Good quality tradeoff observed.

Requirements / constraints:
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for short-chat (<=256 tokens), p99 < 500ms acceptable for longer flows.
- Throughput: steady-state ~15-25 qps; peak bursts to 60-80 qps during feature launches.
- Cost sensitivity: want predictable monthly commit; unwilling to tolerate large unknown overages.
- Security: SOC2 required; SSO/SAML + audit logging + KMS integration mandatory; data residency for EU customers (subset of traffic).

Pricing negotiation notes:
- Customer prefers 12-month committed contract. Proposed starting commit equivalent to 3 dedicated GPU units (baseline) with quarterly ramp add-ons. They requested burst pool that can exceed commit by 2.5x with capped hourly billing.
- AE/Maya proposed three-tier commit options: 1) 12mo $150k ARR (baseline) 2) 12mo $250k ARR (recommended) 3) 12mo $350k ARR (enterprise e2e). Copperline is leaning to mid option if burst SLA and overage floor clarified.
- Overage ask: customer wants per-token overage cap and an optional pre-purchased burst credit bucket to avoid surprise billing. Redwood offered burst at 1.8x baseline with 150% overage rate; Copperline asking for 125% ceiling for first 6 months.
- Ramp schedule: month1 baseline (3 units), month3 +1 unit, month6 +2 units contingent on Q2 feature launch. They want a flexible add-on clause without full re-negotiation.

Quotes from calls: "Need predictable cost for our freemium-to-paid conversion push — budgeting window is Q2 launch" — Head of Product.

Open items: legal needs SOW with explicit ramp table, overage math example, and burst SLA definition. Security wants data residency proof and KMS workflow. Procurement requires PO before start.

Internal notes: AE Maya to push updated term sheet; SE Diego to provide latency tests (p95/p99) on Dedicated profile and sample billing run for expected QPS shape. CSM Anika prepping onboarding plan if deal closes.
